spans.text: Experiment 1: static body emotion matching

description.value: Two-alternative forced-choice simultaneous match-to-sample procedure using static whole-body emotional expression pictures.

spans.text: two-alternative forced choice

instructions.value: Respond as accurately and as fast as possible by indicating with a button press whether the left or right bottom picture displayed the same expression as the one on top.

stimuli.value: Static pictures of whole-body expressions depicting anger, fear, happiness, and sadness.

spans.text: Experiment 2: dynamic body emotion matching

description.value: Two-alternative forced-choice simultaneous match-to-sample procedure using dynamic whole-body emotional expression video clips.

spans.text: two-alternative forced choice

stimuli.value: Two-second video clips of whole-body expressions depicting anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, and neutral expressions.

spans.text: Experiment 3: static face emotion matching

description.value: Two-alternative forced-choice simultaneous match-to-sample procedure using static facial emotional expression pictures.

spans.text: two-alternative forced choice

stimuli.value: Frontal-view pictures of emotional expressions from the Karolinska Directed Emotional Faces set.

spans.text: Experiment 4: dynamic face emotion matching

description.value: Two-alternative forced-choice simultaneous match-to-sample procedure using dynamic facial emotional expression video clips.

spans.text: two-alternative forced choice

stimuli.value: Two-second video clips of facial expressions depicting anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, and neutral expressions.

spans.text: Experiment 5 (control experiment): face identity matching

description.value: Two-alternative forced-choice simultaneous match-to-sample procedure matching face identity rather than emotional expression.

spans.text: two-alternative forced choice

stimuli.value: A front-view face presented on top with two three-quarter-view faces presented below.
